meta.note: All messages are made up training examples. Numbers are masked.

items.text: Caller: Main Central Investigation Bureau se Inspector Verma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel mein drugs mile hain. Aap abhi digital arrest mein ho, call cut mat karna, kisi ko batana mat. Case clear karne ke liye verification account mein paise transfer karne honge.
tells: Digital arrest jaisi koi cheez nahi hoti
Call cut na karne aur secret rakhne ka pressure
Verification ke naam par paisa transfer
items.why: Koi bhi asli police ya agency video call par arrest nahi karti aur paise transfer nahi karwati. Turant call kaato aur 1930 par call karke cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.
items.text_en: Caller: I am Inspector Verma from the Central Investigation Bureau. Drugs have been found in a parcel linked to your Aadhaar. You are now under digital arrest. Do not cut the call, and do not tell anyone. To clear the case you will have to transfer money into a verification account.
tells_en: There is no such thing as digital arrest
Pressure to stay on the call and keep it a secret
A money transfer in the name of verification
items.why_en: No real police officer or agency arrests you on a video call or asks you to transfer money. Cut the call at once, call 1930 and report it on cybercrime.gov.in.

items.text: IVR: Aapka international parcel customs ne rok liya hai. Isme illegal items paaye gaye hain. Customer care se baat karne ke liye 1 dabaiye. Agent: Aapka case cyber police ko transfer kar rahe hain, abhi clearance charge bharna hoga.
tells: Aisa parcel jo aapne bheja hi nahi
Call ko so called police ko transfer karna
Clearance charge ki demand
items.why: Courier company khud kabhi police ko call transfer karke paise nahi maangti. Courier ki official website se number lekar khud check karo aur pressure mein payment mat karo.

link.name: Courier or customs parcel scam (FedEx style)

items.text_en: IVR: Customs has stopped your international parcel. Illegal items were found in it. Press 1 to speak to customer care. Agent: We are transferring your case to the cyber police. You must pay a clearance charge now.
tells_en: A parcel you never sent
The call being transferred to so-called police
A demand for a clearance charge
items.why_en: A courier company never transfers your call to the police and then asks for money. Check the number yourself on the courier's official website, and do not pay under pressure.

items.text: Hi! Hum ek digital marketing company hain. Ghar baithe online videos like karo aur har task par Rs 50 kamao. Aaj hi join karo hamara chat group, pehle 3 task free, phir premium task ke liye chhota deposit.
tells: Bina apply kiye job offer
Sirf like karne ke paise
Premium task ke liye deposit
items.why: Pehle chhota payout dekar trust banate hain, phir deposit ke naam par bada paisa phans jaata hai. Aisi job offer ko ignore karo, group se exit karo aur koi deposit mat karo.

link.name: Task based part time job fraud

items.text_en: Hi! We are a digital marketing company. Like online videos from home and earn Rs 50 per task. Join our chat group today. The first 3 tasks are free, then a small deposit for premium tasks.
tells_en: A job offer you never applied for
Money just for liking videos
A deposit for premium tasks
items.why_en: They first pay a little to build trust, then trap a larger amount as a deposit. Ignore this kind of job offer, leave the group and do not deposit any money.

items.text: Aapko Rs 2,000 receive karne ke liye ek collect request aayi hai from buyer.sofa@examplebank. Paisa paane ke liye app kholo aur apna UPI PIN daalo.
tells: Paisa receive karne ke liye PIN maangna
Anjaan collect request
Jaldi approve karne ka message
items.why: UPI PIN sirf paise bhejne ke liye lagta hai, receive karne ke liye kabhi nahi. Collect request decline karo aur agar paisa kat gaya ho to bank aur 1930 ko turant batao.
items.text_en: A collect request of Rs 2,000 has arrived for you to receive money from buyer.sofa@examplebank. Open the app and enter your UPI PIN to get the money.
tells_en: Asking for your PIN to receive money
A collect request from someone you do not know
A message pushing you to approve quickly
items.why_en: Your UPI PIN is only for sending money, never for receiving it. Decline the collect request, and if money has already left, tell your bank and 1930 at once.

items.text: Dear Customer, aapka ABC Bank account aaj raat KYC pending hone ki wajah se block ho jayega. Turant update karein: http://abc-kyc-update.example.in
tells: Normal mobile number se bank ka SMS
Account block hone ki dhamki
Anjaan link par KYC
items.why: Bank kabhi SMS link se KYC update nahi karwata. KYC sirf branch ya official bank app se karo aur fraud SMS ko Chakshu par report karo.
items.text_en: Dear Customer, your ABC Bank account will be blocked tonight because KYC is pending. Update it at once: http://abc-kyc-update.example.in
tells_en: A bank SMS from an ordinary mobile number
A threat that the account will be blocked
KYC through an unknown link
items.why_en: A bank never asks you to update KYC through an SMS link. Do KYC only at the branch or in the official bank app, and report the fraud SMS on Chakshu.

items.text: Dear consumer, aapka pichle mahine ka bill update nahi hua hai. Aaj raat 9:30 baje aapki bijli kaat di jayegi. Turant Electricity Officer se sampark karein 98XXXXXX52.
tells: Same raat bijli katne ki dhamki
Personal mobile number par officer
Koi official sender ID nahi
items.why: Asli Vidyut Board aise personal number se raat mein connection katne ki dhamki nahi deta. Bill sirf official app ya website par check karo aur is number par call mat karo.
items.text_en: Dear consumer, last month's bill has not been updated. Your electricity will be cut tonight at 9:30. Contact the Electricity Officer at once on 98XXXXXX52.
tells_en: A threat to cut power the same night
An officer on a personal mobile number
No official sender ID
items.why_en: A real electricity board does not threaten to cut your connection at night from a personal number. Check the bill only on the official app or website, and do not call this number.

items.text: Congratulations! Aap hamare VIP stock tips group mein add ho gaye ho. Hamare members roz 20 percent profit kama rahe hain. Neeche diye link se hamari special trading app download karo: https://vip-trade.example.com/app.apk
tells: Guaranteed high returns ka daava
App link private, official store se nahi
Bina pooche group mein add karna
items.why: Aise groups mein fake profit screenshots dikhakar nakli app mein paisa daalwate hain aur withdrawal block ho jaata hai. Group chhodo, app install mat karo aur sirf registered platforms par invest karo.

link.name: Investment tips WhatsApp group and fake trading app

items.text_en: Congratulations! You have been added to our VIP stock tips group. Our members are earning 20 percent profit every day. Download our special trading app from the link below: https://vip-trade.example.com/app.apk
tells_en: A claim of guaranteed high returns
An app link that is private, not from an official store
Being added to a group without being asked
items.why_en: These groups show fake profit screenshots, get you to put money in a fake app, and then block withdrawals. Leave the group, do not install the app, and invest only on registered platforms.

items.text: Namaste! Hamari beti ki shaadi mein aap zaroor aaiye. Shaadi card neeche attached hai. Attachment: Wedding_Card_Invite.apk
tells: Card .apk file mein aana
Anjaan number se invite
Asli card PDF ya photo hota hai
items.why: APK file install karte hi phone mein malware aa sakta hai jo SMS aur OTP padh leta hai. File mat kholo, sender ko alag se call karke confirm karo aur galti se install ho gaya ho to internet band karke 1930 par call karo.
items.text_en: Namaste! Please do come to our daughter's wedding. The wedding card is attached below. Attachment: Wedding_Card_Invite.apk
tells_en: The card arriving as an .apk file
An invite from an unknown number
A real card would be a PDF or a photo
items.why_en: Installing an APK can put malware on the phone that reads SMS and OTPs. Do not open the file. Call the sender on a number you already have, and if you installed it by mistake, turn off the internet and call 1930.

items.sender: ABC Bank Helpline? (number from search result)
items.text: Customer: Mera refund nahi aaya. Agent: Sir, aap ek support app install kariye, screen par jo code aaye wo bataiye, phir apna bank app kholiye, hum refund process kar denge.
tells: Number search result se mila, official site se nahi
Support app install karwana
Screen share ke time bank app kholne ko kehna
items.why: Search results mein nakli customer care number daale jaate hain aur screen share se paisa nikaal lete hain. Helpline sirf official website ya app se lo aur kisi ko screen share mat karo.
items.text_en: Customer: My refund has not arrived. Agent: Sir, please install a support app, tell me the code that appears on the screen, then open your bank app. We will process the refund.
tells_en: The number came from a search result, not the official site
Being asked to install a support app
Being asked to open the bank app during screen share
items.why_en: Fake customer care numbers are planted in search results, and money is stolen during screen share. Take a helpline only from the official website or app, and never share your screen.

items.text: Bhai main army mein hoon, abhi border posting par hoon. Aapki sofa wali online ad dekhi, jo price bola wahi dunga. Payment ke liye ye QR scan karo, paisa seedha aapke account mein aa jayega.
tells: Bina bargaining ke price maan lena
Army posting ka bahana, mil nahi sakta
Paisa lene ke liye QR scan karwana
items.why: Paisa receive karne ke liye kabhi QR scan nahi karna padta, scan karte hi paisa kat sakta hai. Aise buyer se deal band karo aur QR scan mat karo.
items.text_en: Brother, I am in the army, on a border posting right now. I saw your online ad for the sofa and I will pay the price you asked. Scan this QR to take the payment, the money will go straight into your account.
tells_en: Agreeing to the price with no bargaining
An army posting used as a reason they cannot meet
Asking you to scan a QR code to receive money
items.why_en: You never need to scan a QR code to receive money. Scanning it can send your money out. End the deal with this kind of buyer, and do not scan the QR code.

items.text: Traffic Police: Aapki gaadi ka e-challan Rs 500 unpaid hai. 24 ghante mein pay nahi kiya to licence suspend. Pay karein: https://echallan-pay.example.in
tells: Link official transport portal nahi hai
Licence suspend karne ki dhamki
Normal 10 digit number se SMS
items.why: Nakli challan link par card ya UPI details daalte hi paisa chura liya jaata hai. Challan sirf official government e-challan portal par khud type karke check karo.
items.text_en: Traffic Police: Your vehicle has an unpaid e-challan of Rs 500. If you do not pay in 24 hours, your licence will be suspended. Pay here: https://echallan-pay.example.in
tells_en: The link is not the official transport portal
A threat to suspend the licence
An SMS from an ordinary 10 digit number
items.why_en: Entering card or UPI details on a fake challan link lets them steal the money. Check a challan only by typing the official government e-challan portal yourself.

items.text: Aapka loan overdue hai. Aaj shaam tak payment nahi kiya to aapki photos aur details aapke saare contacts ko bhej denge. Last warning.
tells: Contacts ko photos bhejne ki dhamki
Gaali aur pressure wali recovery
Lender RBI registered hai ya nahi, pata nahi
items.why: Aisi dhamki dena harassment hai aur ye illegal loan apps ka pattern hai. Paisa dene ke dabav mein mat aao, evidence save karo aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.
items.text_en: Your loan is overdue. If payment is not made by this evening, we will send your photos and details to all of your contacts. Last warning.
tells_en: A threat to send photos to your contacts
Abusive, high-pressure recovery
No sign that the lender is RBI registered
items.why_en: This kind of threat is harassment, and it is a common pattern of illegal loan apps. Do not pay under this pressure. Save the evidence and report it on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

items.text: Diwali Dhamaka! Branded smartphone sirf Rs 999 mein, 90 percent OFF. Sirf aaj ke liye, stock limited. Sirf prepaid order. Abhi kharido: https://mega-sale.example.com
tells: Discount itna zyada ki sach na lage
Sirf prepaid payment
Sirf aaj ka pressure
items.why: Nakli shopping sites badi discount dikhakar advance paisa le leti hain aur saamaan nahi aata. Sirf jaani maani website par address khud type karke shopping karo.
items.text_en: Diwali blast! A branded smartphone for only Rs 999, 90 percent OFF. Today only, limited stock. Prepaid orders only. Buy now: https://mega-sale.example.com
tells_en: A discount so large it is hard to believe
Prepaid payment only
Pressure that the offer is only for today
items.why_en: Fake shopping sites show a huge discount, take the advance, and never send the goods. Shop only on a website you already know, and type the address yourself.

items.text: Badhai ho! Aapka number Crorepati Lucky Draw mein Rs 25 lakh ke liye chuna gaya hai. Prize release karne ke liye processing fee aur tax jama karein. Manager se baat karein: 98XXXXXX91
tells: Aisi lottery jisme aapne hissa hi nahi liya
Prize ke liye fee aur tax
Anjaan manager ka number
items.why: Jis lottery mein aapne kabhi part hi nahi liya, wo jeet nahi sakte. Koi fee mat bharo aur number ko block karke report karo.
items.text_en: Congratulations! Your number has been chosen in the Crorepati Lucky Draw for Rs 25 lakh. To release the prize, deposit the processing fee and tax. Speak to the manager: 98XXXXXX91
tells_en: A lottery you never entered
A fee and tax to release the prize
An unknown manager's number
items.why_en: You cannot win a lottery you never entered. Do not pay any fee, block the number and report it.

items.text: Hum 2 hafte se baat kar rahe hain, mujhe lagta hai hum perfect hain. Main ek crypto app par trading karti hoon, bahut profit hai. Aap bhi thoda invest karo, main sikha dungi. Ye raha link: https://crypto-earn.example.in
tells: Match jaldi investment ki baat kare
Milne se bachna
Khaas app ya website par push karna
items.why: Rishta ya dating ke naam par trust banakar nakli investment app mein paisa daalwaya jaata hai. Online match ke kehne par kabhi invest mat karo aur profile ko platform par report karo.

link.name: Matrimonial site investment or crypto fraud

items.text_en: We have been talking for 2 weeks, I feel we are a perfect match. I trade on a crypto app and the profit is very good. You should invest a little too, I will teach you. Here is the link: https://crypto-earn.example.in
tells_en: The match turns to investment talk very quickly
Avoiding meeting in person
A push towards a special app or website
items.why_en: In the name of a match or dating, they build trust and then get you to put money into a fake investment app. Never invest because an online match asked you to, and report the profile on the platform.

items.text: Congratulations! Aapka resume select ho gaya hai. Part time job, salary Rs 8,000 per day. Registration ke liye HR se WhatsApp par baat karein: https://wa-jobs.example.com
tells: Job jiske liye apply hi nahi kiya
Bahut zyada salary thode kaam ke liye
Chat sirf WhatsApp par
items.why: Asli company bina interview ke itni salary ka offer SMS par nahi bhejti. Registration ya training fee kabhi mat do.
items.text_en: Congratulations! Your resume has been selected. Part time job, salary Rs 8,000 per day. To register, talk to HR on WhatsApp: https://wa-jobs.example.com
tells_en: A job you never applied for
A very high salary for little work
The chat is only on WhatsApp
items.why_en: A real company does not send an SMS offer of this salary with no interview. Never pay a registration or training fee.

items.text: Yaar ek urgent kaam hai. Tere number par galti se ek 6 digit code chala gaya hai, please mujhe forward kar de jaldi.
tells: Dost ka verification code maangna
Urgency
Code aapke phone par aaya, unke nahi
items.why: Ye code dete hi aapka WhatsApp account hijack ho sakta hai aur aapke contacts se paise maange ja sakte hain. Code kabhi share mat karo aur two step verification on karo.
items.text_en: Yaar, I have something urgent. A 6 digit code has gone to your number by mistake. Please forward it to me quickly.
tells_en: A friend asking for a verification code
Urgency
The code arrived on your phone, not theirs
items.why_en: Sharing that code can let someone take over your WhatsApp account and then ask your contacts for money. Never share the code, and turn on two step verification.

items.text: Caller (beta jaisi awaaz): Papa main musibat mein hoon, mera accident ho gaya hai, police pakad ke le gayi hai. Abhi isi number par UPI se paise bhejo, kisi ko mat batana, phone band ho raha hai.
tells: Naye number se emergency call
Turant paise bhejne ka pressure
Kisi ko na batane ko kehna
items.why: AI se awaaz copy karke family emergency ka drama kiya ja sakta hai. Call kaato aur us vyakti ko unke purane number par khud call karke confirm karo.

link.name: AI voice clone or deepfake emergency call

items.text_en: Caller (in a child's voice): Papa, I am in trouble, I have had an accident, the police have taken me. Send money by UPI to this same number right now, do not tell anyone, the phone is about to die.
tells_en: An emergency call from a new number
Pressure to send money at once
Being told not to tell anyone
items.why_en: A voice can be copied with AI to stage a family emergency. Cut the call and call that person back yourself on the number you already have saved.

items.text: 123456 is your OTP for login to ABC Bank NetBanking. Valid for 5 minutes. Never share your OTP with anyone. ABC Bank never asks for OTP.
tells: Official sender ID
Khud OTP share na karne ki salah
Koi link ya payment ki demand nahi
items.why: Ye normal OTP SMS hai jo tabhi aata hai jab aap khud login karte ho. Isse safe rakhna aapka kaam hai, ise kisi ko mat batao.
items.text_en: 123456 is your OTP for login to ABC Bank NetBanking. Valid for 5 minutes. Never share your OTP with anyone. ABC Bank never asks for OTP.
tells_en: An official sender ID
Advice not to share the OTP
No link and no demand for a payment
items.why_en: This is a normal OTP SMS that arrives when you log in yourself. Keeping it private is your job. Do not tell it to anyone.

items.text: QuickShip Courier: Aapka order QS12XXXX89 aaj out for delivery hai. Delivery agent 2 se 6 baje ke beech aayega. Koi payment due nahi hai.
tells: Koi payment nahi maangi
Koi link ya app install nahi
Order ki saaf jaankari jo aapne kiya tha
items.why: Ye ek normal delivery update hai jisme sirf jaankari hai. Agar aapne order kiya tha to ye genuine lagta hai, phir bhi koi code dial karne ko kahe to mat karna.
items.text_en: QuickShip Courier: Your order QS12XXXX89 is out for delivery today. The delivery agent will come between 2 and 6. No payment is due.
tells_en: No payment is being asked
No link and no app to install
Clear details of an order you actually placed
items.why_en: This is a normal delivery update with information only. If you placed the order, it looks genuine. Still, do not dial any code if someone asks you to.

items.text: ABC Bank: Rs 1,250 debited from A/c XX4821 on 01-11 at QuickMart. Not you? Call the number on the back of your card or use the ABC Bank app.
tells: Account number masked
Koi link nahi
Card ke peeche wale number ya official app par bharosa
items.why: Ye ek transaction alert hai jo aapko official channel par hi bhejta hai. Agar transaction aapka nahi hai to bank ko official number se turant batao.
items.text_en: ABC Bank: Rs 1,250 debited from A/c XX4821 on 01-11 at QuickMart. Not you? Call the number on the back of your card or use the ABC Bank app.
tells_en: The account number is masked
No link
It points you to the number on the card or the official app
items.why_en: This is a transaction alert that sends you only to an official channel. If the transaction is not yours, tell the bank at once on the official number.

items.text: Vidyut Board: Aapka November ka bill Rs 1,840 generate ho gaya hai. Due date 15-11. Payment ke liye official Vidyut Board app ya nearest office use karein.
tells: Koi dhamki ya same day disconnection nahi
Official app aur office ka zikr
Official sender ID
items.why: Ye ek simple bill reminder hai jo official app ki taraf bhejta hai. Isme koi personal number ya urgent dhamki nahi hai.
items.text_en: Vidyut Board: Your November bill of Rs 1,840 has been generated. Due date 15-11. Use the official Vidyut Board app or the nearest office to pay.
tells_en: No threat and no same-day disconnection
A mention of the official app and office
An official sender ID
items.why_en: This is a simple bill reminder that points you to the official app. There is no personal number and no urgent threat.

items.text: Sehat Clinic: Dr. Mehra ke saath aapka appointment kal 11:00 AM par hai. Reschedule karne ke liye clinic reception par call karein.
tells: Koi payment ya link nahi
Aapne khud jo booking ki uski jaankari
Koi personal detail nahi maangi
items.why: Ye ek normal appointment reminder hai. Isme koi pressure, link ya paisa nahi maanga gaya.
items.text_en: Sehat Clinic: Your appointment with Dr. Mehra is tomorrow at 11:00 AM. To reschedule, call the clinic reception.
tells_en: No payment and no link
Details of a booking you made yourself
No personal details are being asked
items.why_en: This is a normal appointment reminder. There is no pressure, no link and no request for money.

items.text: Dear Customer, aapke account mein naye device se login hua. Agar ye aap the to kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi. Agar nahi, to ABC Bank app kholkar password badlein. Hum kabhi email par password ya OTP nahi maangte.
tells: Email mein koi link click karne ko nahi kaha
Khud app kholne ki salah
OTP ya password nahi maanga
items.why: Genuine security alert aapko khud official app kholne ko kehta hai, link par nahi bhejta. Phir bhi shak ho to bank ko official number par confirm karo.
items.text_en: Dear Customer, there was a login to your account from a new device. If this was you, you do not need to do anything. If it was not, open the ABC Bank app and change your password. We never ask for a password or OTP by email.
tells_en: The email does not ask you to click a link
Advice to open the app yourself
No OTP or password is being asked
items.why_en: A genuine security alert asks you to open the official app yourself, and does not send you to a link. If you still have a doubt, confirm with the bank on the official number.

items.text: Beta, Diwali ki bahut shubhkamnayein! Ghar par sab ko pyaar. Agle hafte milte hain.
tells: Jaana pehchana contact
Koi link, file ya paisa nahi
Koi urgency nahi
items.why: Ye ek normal festival greeting hai jisme kuch maanga nahi gaya. Bas dhyaan rahe ki greeting ke saath APK ya anjaan link aaye to mat kholna.
items.text_en: Beta, many good wishes for Diwali! Love to everyone at home. See you next week.
tells_en: A contact you already know
No link, file or request for money
No urgency
items.why_en: This is a normal festival greeting that asks for nothing. Just be careful: if a greeting arrives with an APK or an unknown link, do not open it.

items.sender: ABC Bank (you called the number on your card)
items.text: Aap: Mera card kho gaya hai. Agent: Main aapka card abhi block kar raha hoon. Main aapse koi OTP, PIN ya CVV nahi poochunga. Naya card aapke registered address par aayega.
tells: Call aapne khud card ke peeche wale number par kiya
Agent khud OTP ya PIN nahi maang raha
Koi app install nahi karwaya
items.why: Jab aap khud official number par call karte ho aur koi secret details nahi maangi jaati, to ye genuine process hai. Card kho jaye to turant aise hi block karwana sahi hai.
items.text_en: You: I have lost my card. Agent: I am blocking your card now. I will not ask you for any OTP, PIN or CVV. The new card will come to your registered address.
tells_en: You placed the call yourself to the number on the back of the card
The agent is not asking for an OTP or PIN
You were not asked to install an app
items.why_en: When you call the official number yourself and no secret details are asked for, this is a genuine process. If a card is lost, blocking it this way is the right step.

Koi dhamki nahi
Koi link click karne ka pressure nahi
items.why: Ye ek saaf reminder hai jo official channel ki taraf bhejta hai. Portal ka address hamesha khud type karke kholo.
items.text_en: Property tax reminder: Your property tax is due by 31 March. Use the official Nagar Nigam portal or the ward office to pay. No penalty has been added yet.
tells_en: A mention of the official office and portal
No threat
No pressure to click a link

Official app ya retailer ka zikr
OTP na share karne ki salah

items.text_en: TelcoX: Your prepaid plan will expire in 3 days. To recharge, go to the TelcoX app or any authorised retailer. TelcoX never asks for an OTP or PIN.
tells_en: An official sender ID
A mention of the official app or a retailer
Advice not to share an OTP
items.why_en: This is a normal recharge reminder with no link and no urgent threat. Always recharge from the official app.

items.text: Dear Parents, kal PTM subah 10 baje school campus mein hai. Fees se related koi payment WhatsApp par nahi li jayegi, sirf school office ya official portal par.

Event ki seedhi jaankari
Koi link ya file nahi
items.why: Ye genuine school notice lagta hai kyunki ye khud bolta hai ki payment WhatsApp par nahi hogi. Agar kabhi isi naam se fees ka link aaye to school office se confirm karna.
items.text_en: Dear Parents, the PTM is tomorrow at 10 AM on the school campus. No fees payment will be taken on WhatsApp, only at the school office or the official portal.
tells_en: A clear statement that payment will not be taken on WhatsApp
Straightforward information about the event
No link and no file
items.why_en: This looks like a genuine school notice because it says payment will not happen on WhatsApp. If a fees link ever arrives in the same name, confirm it with the school office.

items.text: ABC Bank: Rs 5,000 credited to A/c XX4821 by NEFT from Rahul K. Available balance aap ABC Bank app mein dekh sakte hain.
tells: Account number masked
Koi PIN ya action maanga nahi
Balance check ke liye official app

items.text_en: ABC Bank: Rs 5,000 credited to A/c XX4821 by NEFT from Rahul K. You can see the available balance in the ABC Bank app.
tells_en: The account number is masked
No PIN or action is being asked

items.why_en: A credit alert does not ask you to do anything, and that is normal. If someone then calls and says money was sent by mistake and you should return it, first check it yourself in the app.
